== Build notes ==
Advertisement dest 23 October 2026. Printed headline and Queens Games line dested from BoardMatt 3 April 2022 frames (File:OSWM German Premiere ad BoardMatt 2022.png and File:OSWM German Premiere booster spread.png). Remaining body text on the frames is unreadably blurred, so it stays off the article. File:OSWM German CCG spread BoardMatt 2022.png is a video still of a hand holding a CCG box over the magazine, not a printed interior.

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Andy Talaga said the advertisement campaign ran in two issues and later issues dropped it. The catalog lists issues 8–11, the four covers he matched.
